comment: FFXIV_ACT_Plugin.dll inside this zip is decompressed at build time; the seven FFXIV_ACT_Plugin.* assemblies it embeds are stripped and patched by tools/prepare_upstream.py. This release is the FFXIV 7.57 hotfix; it also carries the only deucalion payload upstream still ships (1.5.1), which is why Machina resolves the payload by version instead of a region-keyed name.
